metadata.Name: RACE
metadata.Description: RACE is a reading comprehension dataset collected from English exams for middle and high school Chinese students. It consists of near 28,000 passages and near 100,000 questions generated by human experts.
metadata.Paper Title: RACE: Large-scale ReAding Comprehension Dataset From Examinations
Affiliations: Language Technologies Institute, Carnegie Mellon University
metadata.Abstract: We present RACE, a new dataset for benchmark evaluation of methods in the reading comprehension task. Collected from the English exams for middle and high school Chinese students in the age range between 12 to 18, RACE consists of near 28,000 passages and near 100,000 questions generated by human experts (English instructors), and covers a variety of topics which are carefully designed for evaluating the students’ ability in understanding and reasoning.
